description: Add one or more EXISTING test cases to a suite (appended in order). `tcIds` takes ids or business keys (e.g. TC_123); use suite_list / tc_list to find them. To pin a VERSION, pass `testCases:[{ tcId:"TC-12826", version:"v2.0" }]` (or `versionId`) — the same test case can sit in the suite once per version (v1.0 and v2.0 are two rows). A requested version that does not exist is an ERROR (nothing is added twice as v1.0). `version:"latest"` picks the test case's NEWEST version (highest vMAJOR.MINOR). Default = the test case's current version, which is NOT always the newest — the reply says which version each test case got and warns when a newer one exists; an (tc, version) pair already in the suite is skipped and reported as skipped. NOTE: a suite can only hold test cases of ONE category (all manual OR all automated) — the product rejects a mix. Returns the updated suite.

suiteId.description: The suite id to add to (from suite_list).

tcIds.description: Test case ids / business keys to add (their current version).

testCases.description: Test cases with an explicit version — lets one TC be added once per version.

tcId.description: Test case id or business key.

version.description: Pin this version NAME (e.g. "v2.0"), or "latest" for the newest; ignored when versionId is given.

versionId.description: Pin this version id (from the TC versions[]).

name: suite_add_testcases
title: Add test cases to a suite (optionally a specific VERSION of each)
